jobs.title: Armed Security Officer (48380)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Armed Security Officer (48380) Austin (10234) - Austin, TX 78744 Overview Salary Range $21.93 Hourly Description

Overview

Founded in 1973, Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is a leading US-owned security company, providing integrated security solutions to government and commercial customers on four continents. Inter-Con remains under family ownership and control and operates as the industry leader in the field of customized, high-requirement security solutions. Inter-Con employs over 25,000 security personnel worldwide, trained and managed by a team of professionals with unsurpassed military, law enforcement, and security experience. Inter-Con is Everywhere Security Matters.

Why Work at Inter-Con?

Passion: Inter-Con is a thriving company that is passionate about its products and people. Joining the Inter-Con family is an opportunity for growth and career advancement in an environment that truly cares for its employees. By joining the Inter-Con family, you're working with the best to build a safer future.

People: Inter-Con is more than a company, it's an alumni base. We believe in positioning the right people in the right place to help them achieve their long-term aspirations for career growth. We have transitioned thousands of officers into successful careers in law enforcement, government services, foreign affairs and many more. Your career success drives our success.

Benefits: Inter-Con offers excellent full-time and part-time benefits that include: flexible scheduling to accommodate lifestyle commitments, vacation, sick leave, medical, dental, sponsorship for Top Secret Clearance, comprehensive training, discounts on higher education and much more.

Partner with us to begin a journey that begins with a commitment and leads to a career of a lifetime. Stand out. Be proud. Be Inter-Con!

Employment Opportunity

Sometimes the threat to life, destruction of critical infrastructure or damage to the environment is so severe that a specially trained and equipped security force is needed. When that happens, Inter-Con turns to its Security Officers. As part of this elite team you will secure some of our most vital assets. You will be trained in enhanced security procedures and be exposed to cutting edge technology. The qualifications are high and the training is rigorous, but if you make it you'll join one of the most exclusive clubs in the Inter-Con family. As an Security Officer you are at the tip of the spear when it comes to the advanced security solutions we provide our clients every day.

Specific benefits include:

  • Recognition and Reward Programs.
  • Training and Career Development.
  • Opportunities for Medical, dental, Holidays, vacation and sick, and 401 (k) retirement plan.
  • Uniform and equipment provided
  • Additional benefits vary depending on position.

Employment Opportunity

At Inter-Con we take pride in providing customized security solutions for our clients. To us, that means the right officer in the right place and at the right time. In many cases our clients desire a softer security plan that meets their values and needs, but where high value people and assets are involved, others may prefer a more obvious security presence. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you will be part of a highly trained security team that supports critical facilities and infrastructure, public venues that required an enhanced presence and personal protective services. You'll be trained by our team of highly qualified firearms instructors in safe weapons handling and marksmanship. As an Unarmed Security Officer, you are an integral part of the broad spectrum of specialized security services Inter-Con provides its clients every day.

Job Description

SECURITY OFFICERS: Armed and Unarmed Security Officers with the following qualifications and requirements:

UNARMED SECURITY OFFICERS: Security officers that have a minimum of one year of security officer experience within the last three years, excluding training, and possess a valid security officer license.

ARMED SECURITY OFFICERS: Security officers with a minimum of three years of experience within the last five years of experience as an armed security officer, excluding training and possess a valid security officer license, specifically trained in personal protection by Texas DPS and possess the required state of Texas permits and directives to carry a weapon or concealed weapon.

All security personnel must:

Have the knowledge and skills to use a computer and be familiar with the operation of computers.

Able to complete Electronic Shift Activity Reports on a computer. The submitted information must be correct and convey complete and accurate information.

Be a high school graduate or hold a GED.

Report for duty in a neat, clean, pressed, and in good physical condition uniform and required equipment. Not depart assigned duty area(s) until properly relieved. Under no circumstances must any assigned duty area be left abandoned.

Maintain valid security licenses throughout the contract. Client reserves the right to request copies of proof of valid licenses throughout the contract.

Be fluent in English with the ability to receive, give and understand written and oral instructions.

Not use Client equipment for personal use. Use of Client property for personal use is grounds for removal of personnel from the contract.

Remain awake and alert during the duration of their shift.

Be polite and show respect for others to including Client employees, contractors, and visitors, and a high level of professionalism and a business-like demeanor always.

Use proper business, telephone and two-way radio etiquette.

Maintain a neat and clean appearance and dressed in appropriate uniform when on Client property.

Be able to walk unassisted a minimum of 300 yards, climb 3 flights of stairs, and be able to lift and carry 50 pounds.

All personnel who will be driving to perform the services under this contract or drive to and from Client work locations must:

. Possess a valid Driver License acceptable in the state of Texas.

. Have no Driving Under Influence (DUI) or Driving While Intoxicated (DWI) incidents on driving record within the past three years.

. Have no more than two moving violations on driving record within the past three years.

Work Environment and Schedule

  • Job operates in client sites which could be indoors or outdoors.
  • Position requires prolonged standing and walking, in the performance of daily security activities.
  • Open availability Nights, Weekends, Holidays and overtime as directed(overtime occurs).
  • Work various shifts and Holidays as assigned.

Veterans

Inter-Con is passionate about hiring veterans. In fact, we've hired thousands of veterans over the years and plan to keep hiring as many as we can. If you are veteran in search of a rewarding career among a team that holds an affinity for those who served as well as values your success and growth within our organization, please take a moment to review our website for all our extensive opportunities. Visit www.icsecurity.com/careers/for more information.

Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc. is an affirmative action employer who provides equal employment opportunities to minorities, females, veterans, and disabled individuals, as well as other protected groups. License PPO# 6822

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

As a Security Guard Texas Level III Armed Patrol Driver - Part Time in Austin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform. Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As an Armed Patrol Officer at a retail location, you will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, respond to security-related concerns, and provide outstanding customer service. This driving position requires a valid driver's license and Level III Armed Certification. Join Allied Universal's caring, agile team and bring integrity, reliability, and professionalism to every shift.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $26.50 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeFri06:00 AM - 02:45 PMSat06:00 AM - 02:45 PMSun06:00 AM - 02:45 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to customers, employees, and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents, disturbances, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established protocols and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols of retail sales areas, entrances, parking areas, loading docks, and the surrounding perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access points and observe customer and employee activity for potential security-related concerns, escalating issues to site leadership and/or emergency services as appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate daily activity reports, incident documentation, and required equipment records in accordance with Allied Universal and site procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Possess at least 3 years of combined law enforcement, corrections, or military experience, or at least 5 years of armed security experience.
  • A valid driver's license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Possess a Level III Armed Certification in Texas.
  • Be at least 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Participate in industry-specific security training programs.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. NOW HIRING — COMMISSIONED SECURITY OFFICERS | Greater Austin

Starting at $23/hour | Full-Time + Overtime | Outdoor Foot Patrol

Ranger Protection Agency isn't looking for officers to sit in a vehicle and observe from a distance. We are a “Boots on the Ground — Resolve & Report” private security agency looking for qualified, like-minded professionals who are comfortable being proactive and handling issues on property.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Only applicants who meet ALL of the following will be considered at this time:

  • Current Texas Level III (Armed) Commissioned Security Officer License
  • Own firearm and at least one less-lethal option (O/C, baton, or Taser) with appropriate training/certification
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable personal vehicle
  • Currently live and/or work in the Greater Austin area
  • Able to pass a drug test

THE POSITION

These are outdoor foot-patrol positions at apartment communities and retail centers in the greater Austin area.

Our officers do more than observe and report. Ranger's Resolve & Report approach includes:

  • Addressing lease violations
  • Issuing Criminal Trespass Warnings
  • Utilizing lawful arrest authority when appropriate
  • Proactively addressing suspicious or criminal activity
  • Maintaining a visible security presence and interacting with residents, management, and law enforcement

For individuals interested in pursuing a career in law enforcement, Ranger provides an opportunity to gain relevant, hands-on field experience while developing communication, documentation, de-escalation, decision-making, and enforcement skills.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Starting at $23/hour

  • Full-time positions
  • Set weekly schedule
  • Bi-weekly pay
  • Subsidized health insurance
  • Accrued Paid Time Off
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discounts
  • Professional development assistance
  • Training and advancement opportunities

If you're looking for a security job where getting out, engaging, problem-solving, and making a difference on the properties you protect is the rule—not the exception—we want to hear from you.

Job Description
Overview
The Armed Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of residents, visitors, and property within the apartment complex.
This position involves maintaining a visible presence, enforcing community rules, and responding to security incidents with professionalism and discretion.
Responsibilities
* Patrol the apartment grounds, parking lots, and common areas to deter unauthorized activity and ensure resident safety.
* Respond promptly to calls for service, disturbances, or suspicious activity.
* Enforce property policies and regulations while maintaining a respectful and professional demeanor with residents and guests.
* Conduct vehicle and foot patrols to prevent trespassing, vandalism, theft, and other unlawful acts.
* Prepare detailed hourly reports using our tracktik security system, on activities, incidents, and observations.
* Coordinate with law enforcement and emergency responders when necessary.
* Provide assistance to residents, management, and contractors as needed to maintain a safe environment.
Qualifications
* Must possess a valid armed security officer license or certification as required by state law.
* Proven experience in security, law enforcement, or military service preferred.
* Excellent communication and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to remain calm and act decisively during high-stress situations.
* Must be able to stand, walk, and patrol for extended periods and work in various weather conditions.
* Professional appearance and conduct required at all times.
* Join us in ensuring safety and security within our community by applying for the Armed Security Officer position today!

jobs.title: Security Guard Armed Patrol Driver Texas
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Guard Armed Patrol Driver Texas in Austin, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Retail/Malls, and more. As an Armed Patrol Officer at a retail and mall location, you will conduct routine vehicle and foot patrols, maintain a visible presence to help deter incidents, and respond to security-related concerns with professionalism. This driving position also focuses on exceptional customer service, clear communication, and teamwork. Join Allied Universal's agile, reliable, and innovative team, where people come first and integrity guides every action.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $26.00 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon02:00 PM - 10:00 PMTue02:00 PM - 10:00 PMFri02:00 PM - 10:00 PMSat02:00 PM - 10:00 PMSun02:00 PM - 10:00 PM

What You'll Do:

  • Provide customer service to clients, visitors, and staff by carrying out armed security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following applicable site procedures and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct regular and random armed patrols throughout the retail location, including interior areas, exterior grounds, parking areas, and perimeter access points.
  • Monitor for suspicious activity, unauthorized access, hazardous conditions, and policy violations, helping to deter incidents through a visible professional presence.
  • Document patrols, incidents, observations, and interactions accurately, and communicate relevant information to site contacts and Allied Universal leadership.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Possess at least 3 years of combined law enforcement, corrections, or military experience, or at least 5 years of armed security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • A valid driver's license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • A Level III Armed Certification is required in Texas.
  • Be at least 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Participate in industry-specific security training programs.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
